title: Mike Vrabel no longer thinks the photos of he and Dianna Russini are ‘laughable’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel no longer thinks the photos of he and Dianna Russini are ‘laughable’
sources.description: One reporter asked the Patriots coach directly if he still felt that the implication of the photos was “laughable,” as he had said in his initial statement to Page Six.
